Webinar Deal Attribution

Webinar Deal Attribution tells you which webinars actually helped close your deals.
It connects your webinar attendees to the CRM deals they influenced and shows how much revenue each webinar contributed.
Enable Deal Revenue Attribution
Deal Attribution is optional. You can enable it later from the integration settings if you'd prefer to skip this for now.
Choose the Revenue Attribution Type
A record attends webinars A → B → C, and then the deal closes. Webinar A gets 100% of the revenue because it was the first webinar attended.
First Webinar Interaction
Attributes 100% of the deal revenue to the earliest webinar attended.
A record attends webinars A → B → C, and then the deal closes. Webinar C gets 100% of the revenue because it was the most recent webinar before closure.
Last Webinar Interaction
Attributes 100% of the deal revenue to the most recent webinar attended.
A record attends webinars A → B → C → D, and the deal closes. Each webinar gets 25% of the revenue equally.
Linear
Distributes the deal revenue equally across all webinars attended.
Earlier webinars in the journey get more credit than later ones. Best when early awareness matters most.
Increasing Time Decay
Assigns more credit to earlier webinars and gradually less to later ones.
Recent webinars in the journey get more credit than earlier ones. Best when the last few touchpoints matter most.
Decreasing Time Decay
Assigns more credit to the most recent webinars and gradually less to earlier ones.
First and last webinars each get 40%. Middle webinars share 20%. Best for U-shaped journeys.
Position-Based
Gives 40% to first, 40% to last, 20% split across in-between webinars.

Webinar Deal Attribution
Connects webinar attendees to CRM deals and shows how much revenue each webinar contributed.

Configure how webinar attendance contributes to deal revenue attribution.

Enable Deal Attribution
Enable Deal Revenue Attribution
Modify Model
Attribution Model
First Webinar Interaction

Attributes 100% of the deal revenue to the earliest webinar attended by the associated record prior to deal closure.

You have unsaved changes
Choose the Revenue Attribution Type
First Webinar Interaction
A record attends three webinars: A → B → C, and then the deal closes.
In this model, Webinar A gets 100% of the deal revenue because it was the first webinar attended.

Attributes 100% of the deal revenue to the earliest webinar attended by the associated record prior to deal closure.

Last Webinar Interaction
A record attends three webinars: A → B → C, and then the deal closes.
In this model, Webinar C gets 100% of the revenue because it was the most recent webinar before closure.

Attributes 100% of the deal revenue to the most recent webinar attended by the associated record before the deal was closed.

Linear
A record attends three webinars: A → B → C, and then the deal closes.
In this model, each webinar gets an equal share — 33.3% each — of the total deal revenue.

Distributes the deal revenue equally across all webinars attended by the associated record before the deal was closed.

Increasing Time Decay
A record attends webinars A → B → C → D, and then the deal closes.
Webinar A (earliest) gets the most credit. Credit decreases progressively for each later webinar.

Assigns more revenue credit to earlier webinars and gradually less to later ones, based on how early they occurred in the journey.

Decreasing Time Decay
A record attends webinars A → B → C → D, and then the deal closes.
Webinar D (closest to deal closure) gets the most credit. Credit decreases for earlier webinars.

Assigns more revenue credit to the most recent webinars and gradually less to the earlier ones, based on how close they occurred to the deal closure.

Position-Based
A record attends webinars A → B → C → D, and then the deal closes.
Webinar A (first) and Webinar D (last) each get 40% of the deal revenue. The remaining 20% is split equally across B and C.

Gives 40% of deal revenue to the first webinar attended and 40% to the last, with the remaining 20% distributed equally across all webinars in between.
